description: entryKey derivation cases for the FPP plugin coordinator contract, docs/build/FPP-PLUGIN-COORDINATOR-CONTRACTS.md section 1.3. expectedCanonicalKeyObject is the exact RFC 8785 canonical text of the five-member object {instanceUuid, playlistHash, playlistName, position, section} before hashing, so a consumer can tell a canonicalization bug apart from a hashing bug. expectedEntryKey is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of those canonical bytes. A consumer builds the five-member object from identity, canonicalizes it with its own canonicalizer, compares against expectedCanonicalKeyObject, then hashes and compares against expectedEntryKey.

cases.name: baseline
cases.description: A baseline identity: all five fields present and non-empty.

cases.name: duplicate-filename-different-position
cases.description: Identical to baseline except position is 1 instead of 0. This is the duplicate-filename case the entry-key design exists for: two entries with the same sequenceName in the same playlist at different positions must not collide, and this differs from baseline only in position.

cases.name: field-changed-instanceUuid
cases.description: Identical to baseline except instanceUuid changes. Verifies changing instanceUuid alone changes the key.

cases.name: field-changed-playlistHash
cases.description: Identical to baseline except playlistHash changes. Verifies changing playlistHash alone changes the key.

cases.name: field-changed-playlistName
cases.description: Identical to baseline except playlistName changes. Verifies changing playlistName alone changes the key.

cases.name: field-changed-section
cases.description: Identical to baseline except section changes. Verifies changing section alone changes the key.

cases.name: near-collision-pair-a
cases.description: Half of a near-collision pair with near-collision-pair-b. playlistName is "show:1" and section is "main". Under a naive delimiter-joined key such as playlistName + ":" + section, this would join to "show:1:main". near-collision-pair-b's playlistName "show" and section "1|main" would join, under a naive playlistName + "|" + section scheme reusing the same separator family, to a string built from the same characters in a different split. The entryKey object encoding keeps instanceUuid, playlistHash, playlistName, position, and section as distinct JSON members, so no character embedded in one field can be reinterpreted as a boundary between fields; assert this case's key differs from near-collision-pair-b's.

cases.name: near-collision-pair-b
cases.description: Half of a near-collision pair with near-collision-pair-a. playlistName is "show" and section is "1|main", carrying both a colon-family and pipe-family separator character inside the section field. Assert this case's key differs from near-collision-pair-a's.

cases.name: empty-section
cases.description: Identical to baseline except section is the empty string, which contract section 1.2 allows explicitly ("section may be empty").

cases.name: large-position
cases.description: Identical to baseline except position is 2147483647 (32-bit signed integer max), exercising a large integer through ECMAScript number formatting.
